title: Our Approach
description: How SilkCover Consulting runs an assignment: four stages from first question to final result.

menu.label: Our Approach
menu.blurb: How an assignment moves from question to result.

hero.title: From the first question to a result you can use
hero.lede: Every assignment moves through the same four stages. Each one builds on the last, so nothing is designed before it is understood.

stages.title: Listen
stages.text: Understand the decision you face, the context around it and the people it affects.
stages.receive: An inception note setting out the questions, scope and timeline we have agreed.
stages.you: A briefing, and access to the documents and people who know the context.

stages.title: Evidence
stages.text: Gather and test the facts with methods suited to the setting and the question.
stages.receive: Clean data, field notes and a briefing on emerging findings.
stages.you: Introductions and permissions that open the right doors.

stages.title: Design
stages.text: Turn findings into practical options with clear trade-offs and costs.
stages.receive: A draft report, plan or strategy with options and recommendations.
stages.you: Review and feedback, so the final version fits how you work.

stages.title: Deliver
stages.text: Implement, report and learn, so the next decision starts from a stronger base.
stages.receive: Final deliverables, a presentation of results and handover materials.
stages.you: Decisions on next steps, with our support if you want it.

section.title: Principles that hold across every stage

items.title: Context first
items.text: Methods, language and timing are chosen for the setting, not copied from a template.

items.title: Ethical and safe
items.text: Informed consent, data protection and participant safety come before deadlines.

items.title: Multilingual by design
items.text: Interpretation and translated materials are planned from the start, not added at the end.

items.title: Usable outputs
items.text: Every deliverable is written to be acted on: short, clear and honest about uncertainty.

closing.title: Begin with a conversation
closing.text: Stage one starts with listening. Tell us about the question you are facing.
